```{r libraries}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(deeptime)

# Define technology color palette matching Figure 5
technology_palette <- c(
  "ONT dRNA" = "#56B4E9",  # Soft Blue
  "ONT cDNA" = "#4A5899",  # Sandy gold
  "Iso-Seq"   = "#EE7B30",  # Orange
  "Kinnex"   = "#e31c93"   # PacBio pink
)

lab_text_palette <- c(
  "ONT dRNA" = "#FFFFFF",  # Soft Blue
  "ONT cDNA" = "#FFFFFF",  # Deep Blue
  "Iso-Seq"   = "#FFFFFF",  # Soft Orange
  "Kinnex"   = "#FFFFFF"   # Vermilion/Orange-Red
)
```

```{r load_data}
# Read sensitivity data files
read_sensitivity <- function(file_path, dataset, technology, spike_in) {
  df <- read.csv(file_path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$dataset <- dataset
  df$technology <- technology
  df$spike_in <- spike_in
  return(df)
}

sensitivity_data_list <- list()

# 1. Mouse SIRVs (NIH dataset has no ERCC)
sensitivity_data_list[[1]] <- read_sensitivity("data/nih/ont_sensitivity_sirv_summary.csv", "Mouse", "ONT cDNA", "SIRV")
sensitivity_data_list[[2]] <- read_sensitivity("data/nih/isoseq_sensitivity_sirv_summary.csv", "Mouse", "Iso-Seq", "SIRV")
sensitivity_data_list[[3]] <- read_sensitivity("data/nih/masseq_sensitivity_sirv_summary.csv", "Mouse", "Kinnex", "SIRV")

# 2. iNeurons SIRVs
sensitivity_data_list[[4]] <- read_sensitivity("data/neuron/ont_sensitivity_sirv_summary.csv", "iNeuron", "ONT cDNA", "SIRV")
sensitivity_data_list[[5]] <- read_sensitivity("data/neuron/kinnex_sensitivity_sirv_summary.csv", "iNeuron", "Kinnex", "SIRV")

# 3. LongBench SIRVs
sensitivity_data_list[[6]] <- read_sensitivity("data/longbench/cDNA_norm_sensitivity_sirv_summary.csv", "LongBench", "ONT cDNA", "SIRV")
sensitivity_data_list[[7]] <- read_sensitivity("data/longbench/drna_sensitivity_sirv_summary.csv", "LongBench", "ONT dRNA", "SIRV")
sensitivity_data_list[[8]] <- read_sensitivity("data/longbench/kinnex_sensitivity_sirv_summary.csv", "LongBench", "Kinnex", "SIRV")

# 4. iNeurons ERCCs
sensitivity_data_list[[9]] <- read_sensitivity("data/neuron/neuron_ont_sensitivity_ercc_summary.csv", "iNeuron", "ONT cDNA", "ERCC")
sensitivity_data_list[[10]] <- read_sensitivity("data/neuron/neuron_pb_sensitivity_ercc_summary.csv", "iNeuron", "Kinnex", "ERCC")

# 5. LongBench ERCCs
sensitivity_data_list[[11]] <- read_sensitivity("data/longbench/cDNA_norm_sensitivity_ercc_summary.csv", "LongBench", "ONT cDNA", "ERCC")
sensitivity_data_list[[12]] <- read_sensitivity("data/longbench/drna_norm_sensitivity_ercc_summary.csv", "LongBench", "ONT dRNA", "ERCC")
sensitivity_data_list[[13]] <- read_sensitivity("data/longbench/kinnex_norm_sensitivity_ercc_summary.csv", "LongBench", "Kinnex", "ERCC")

# Combine datasets
combined_sensitivity <- do.call(rbind, sensitivity_data_list)

# Add dummy ERCC row for Mouse to preserve ERCC column in facet_grid layout
dummy_row <- data.frame(
  Sample = "dummy",
  Detected_SIRVs = NA,
  Sensitivity = NA,
  Tool = "bambu",
  dataset = "Mouse",
  technology = "ONT cDNA",
  spike_in = "ERCC",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
combined_sensitivity <- rbind(combined_sensitivity, dummy_row)
```

```{r summarize}
# Summarize data by calculating mean and standard deviation
sensitivity_summary <- combined_sensitivity %>%
  group_by(dataset, technology, spike_in, Tool) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_sens = mean(Sensitivity, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_sens = sd(Sensitivity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Replace NaN mean with NA (for the dummy Mouse ERCC row)
sensitivity_summary$mean_sens[is.nan(sensitivity_summary$mean_sens)] <- NA

# Set factors for ordering and consistency
sensitivity_summary <- sensitivity_summary %>%
  mutate(
    Tool = case_when(
      Tool == "flair"    ~ "FLAIR",
      Tool == "isoquant" ~ "IsoQuant",
      Tool == "kallisto" ~ "Kallisto",
      Tool == "oarfish"  ~ "Oarfish",
      Tool == "bambu"    ~ "Bambu",
      TRUE               ~ as.character(Tool)
    ),
    Tool = factor(Tool, levels = c("Bambu", "FLAIR", "IsoQuant", "Kallisto", "Oarfish"))
  )
sensitivity_summary$spike_in <- factor(sensitivity_summary$spike_in, levels = c("SIRV", "ERCC"))
```

```{r theme_and_colors}
# Strict Nature-style theme
theme_nature <- function(base_size = 6.5, base_family = "sans") {
  theme_classic(base_size = base_size, base_family = base_family) +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35, colour = "black"),
      axis.title = element_text(size = base_size),
      axis.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.5, color = "black"),
      legend.title = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3),
      legend.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.7),
      strip.text = element_text(size = base_size - 0.3, face = "bold"),
      strip.text.y = element_text(size = 5.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 2, r = 2, b = 2, l = 2)),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "none" # No color legend since fill is neutral
    )
}
```

```{r generate_plots}
# Generate plots for each dataset
datasets <- c("Mouse", "iNeuron", "LongBench")
l_plots <- list()
dataset_titles <- c("Mouse" = "Mouse", "iNeuron" = "iNeuron", "LongBench" = "LongBench")

for (my_dataset in datasets) {
  l_plots[[my_dataset]] <- sensitivity_summary %>%
    filter(dataset == my_dataset) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Tool, y = mean_sens)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "grey75", color = "black", linewidth = 0.25, width = 0.6) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(0, mean_sens - sd_sens), ymax = pmin(1, mean_sens + sd_sens)), width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.25, color = "black") +
    facet_grid_color(technology ~ spike_in, colors = technology_palette, lab_colors = lab_text_palette) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Sensitivity", title = dataset_titles[my_dataset]) +
    theme_nature() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 5.0))
}
```

```{r assemble}
# Combine the three dataset plots using patchwork
fig3_sensitivity <- l_plots$Mouse / l_plots$LongBench / l_plots$iNeuron +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a") &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"))
```

```{r export}
# Save function
save_pub_r <- function(plot, filename, width_mm = 180, height_mm = 240, dpi = 600) {
  w <- width_mm / 25.4
  h <- height_mm / 25.4

  # Lossless Vector SVG
  svglite::svglite(paste0(filename, ".svg"), width = w, height = h)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  # Vector PDF with embedded fonts
  grDevices::cairo_pdf(paste0(filename, ".pdf"), width = w, height = h, family = "sans")
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  # High-DPI TIFF for publication print
  ragg::agg_tiff(paste0(filename, ".tiff"), width = w, height = h, units = "in", res = dpi)
  print(plot)
  dev.off()

  # PNG for rapid preview
  ggsave(paste0(filename, ".png"), plot, width = w, height = h, dpi = 150)
}

save_pub_r(fig3_sensitivity, "plots/Supplementary_Figure_13", width_mm = 135, height_mm = 190)
```
